items.title: The $1.5 Trillion Question Nvidia’s Earnings Can’t Answer
items.summary: ​📈 Follow our live markets data and coverage.  When tech companies started amping up spending on AI about three years ago, David Cahn, a venture capitalist at Sequoia Capital, asked a simple question: What was the gap between AI investment and the revenue generated from AI?  It certainly won’t weigh on investors this afternoon, when  Nvidia  —the main chip supplier to the AI boom—reports quarterly results.
